purpose: Provider acquires and operates industry-specific domains; customer websites receive individual subdomains under an appropriate verified provider-controlled parent.

domainInventory.ownershipProof: requires live read-only registry/zone check before binding

expansionPolicy.rootDomains: add as many independently verified provider-managed industry domains as operations approve; no fixed restriction to nalmada.net
expansionPolicy.procurement: Domain selection, pricing, purchase and ownership authorization are separate operations; never infer purchase from a sample root.
expansionPolicy.provisionedCustomerHost: unique customer slug + verified parent root; explicit reservation, route+DNS+certificate+origin readback required
noUnverifiedPromises: Do not show sample host as live
Do not imply customer acquires the apex domain
Do not promise arbitrary wildcard SSL before cert/route verified
Do not mark DNS attach from git config alone
expansionPolicy.seoAndPrivacy: Store distinct customer fact sheets; verify business name/service regions. Hostname must not spoof unrelated businesses.

cloudflare.dispatcherIfScaleJustifies: Optional hostname-aware route+worker dispatch; not implemented or deployed
